settings.offlineCapabilityIntro: Kyarafit keeps working when you lose signal. Edits queue locally and sync automatically when you are back online.

accountPage.dataPrivacyBody: Kyarafit stores your account details, cosplay builds, uploaded images, and convention plans in the cloud when you're signed in. On this device, auth tokens are stored securely so you stay signed in.
accountPage.deleteExplainer: Deleting your account permanently removes your cloud-synced profile, builds, convention plans, and uploaded images. Local-only data created while browsing without an account is not part of your cloud profile.

accountPage.oauthErrorUnableToLink: Could not connect that sign-in method. It may already be used on another Kyarafit account.
accountPage.oauthErrorAlreadyLinked: That provider is already linked to a different Kyarafit account.
